source_uncertainties: No cluster scheduler is installed locally; scheduler template is explicitly unsubmitted, with no claimed local job allocation. The recorded interactive/batch visibility difference is site-specific.
The course-provided example repository URL was not established from the inspected frames; examples were reconstructed from visible source rather than claiming a clone or audit of that repository.
The displayed precision timings are retained as lecture observations; their cause is not independently established. No peak ratio inferred.
The recorded later SM-counter job environment is not fully established; array indexing is identified as a potential out-of-bounds defect rather than a reproduced memory fault.
Current online manuals identify CUDA13.4/PTX9.4; installed tools areCUDA13.3/PTX9.3. Local generated-artifact and execution claims use actual captures.

Three complete timing captures retained. A60secondNode wrapper reset after artifact and two repetitions were saved; an unretained third repetition is excluded from results. No trace-based copy/compute overlap was measured.
